name: FFS_QBI_BOOKING_STATUS_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: QUOTA_LOG_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies log record of booking status changes.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Who Column: Time in GMT when action was performed.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who Column: Identifies user the operation is performed by. Zero value means internal application task. Foreign Key. Points to USER_ID in FFS_USER.

columns.name: PAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to PAGE_ID in FFS_QBI_QUOTA_PAGE.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_SKILL_ID in FFS_WORK_SKILL.

columns.name: WORK_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_ZONE_ID in FFS_WORK_ZONE.

columns.name: CLOSED_AT
columns.description: Time when this quota cell was closed. Capacity area time zone is used.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Start time in minutes of booking interval since midnight.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: End time in minutes of booking interval since midnight.

columns.name: OLD_OPTIONS
columns.description: Old value of bitmask field that defines status of a corresponding quota cell.

columns.name: NEW_OPTIONS
columns.description: New value of bitmask field that defines status of a corresponding quota cell.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
